I will check sqlite.CreateMemo to confirm it performs the INSERT, and store.CreateMemo to verify it delegates to the driver.

The default driver is SQLite. This is set by viper.SetDefault in cmd/memos/main.go:122 and by PersistentFlags at line 130.

The concrete method is `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`. The call chain is `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` → `Store.CreateMemo` → `driver.CreateMemo`, which routes to the SQLite factory switch case. This was determined by tracing the default driver flag through the factory switch and excluding MySQL and Postgres candidates.

h12.
(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo — store/db/sqlite/memo.go; default driver is sqlite (`cmd/memos/main.go` viper/flag default), selected by `db.NewDBDriver` (`store/db/db.go`)

With no `--driver`/`--dsn`, `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` and the `--driver` flag default both pick SQLite. `NewDBDriver` then calls `sqlite.NewDB`. Saving a memo goes `Store.CreateMemo` → `driver.CreateMemo`; only the SQLite method runs the `INSERT INTO memo`. MySQL and Postgres have the same method name but are not constructed on that path.
